name: bare-fist
unmodelled: Closed Hand Vow (ward efficiency +100 with no damaging art slotted): the rebuilt loadout slots damaging arts (strata-hammer, last-breath-fist, bulwark-knuckle), so the Vow would be void; the old file only folded it into the ward drain floor, and that ward is kept unchanged

Stored Breath, Quiet Channels, Settled Dust, Still Water, Unyielding Breath, Elemental Fist, Steady Breath, Full Sea, Bare Rack: never expressed as effects in the old file, so not added now (Stored Breath belonged to the invented Uncarved Stone Fist, which has no library equivalent)
basic_speed_pct and basic_coef_add (old guide: +50 % speed, +1.2 coefficient): not in the old file's fields; not added

Layered wards (Common Ward, Qi-Scattering Robe, Mountain Screen, Iron Shirt, Clear Heart Ward and others) are modelled as the one drain ward of the old file; reserved-ward payloads, ward shields and per-hit wards are not modelled
mountain-stance (mountain-heart-canon L1) left out: its state slows the basic attack by 40 percent, against the concept, and the engine would toggle it on cooldown
